title: Install and prove five tripwires for four deferred re-shadows, plus the path convention they rest on
objective: Close #319. Six issues were deferred with the trigger written as PROSE; only badf-uat had a mechanical watch. #166's own docstring says its trigger 'is prose and has waited on a human noticing'. Adds one watch per deferral for #251, #217, #166 and #185, plus a fifth asserting the examples/-vs-work/ path convention the other four use to decide 'is it real?'.
business_value: A caveat that depends on someone remembering is the silence C11 refuses. Five capabilities are ACTIVE carrying undischarged caveats parked on triggers nobody watches; after this, each trigger is a fact a test reads rather than a sentence someone must re-read.
in_scope: tests/test_badf_deferred_tripwires.py: five watches (#251, #217, #166, #185, and the path convention), each carrying an aim proof of read site, matcher and reach
carry the WP-2026-0134 reconcile (derived at base 310a660, byte-identical to #316/#321/#326/#327; NOT #314's, which asserts 129183c1 at 5400 bytes)
out_of_scope: #212: its four control inputs are PRESENT in 22, 25, 1 and 0 records, so its caveat cannot be watched by a presence scan, and its trigger names a controller marker build/session.json does not carry. Split into four arms by SARCHI; a reading, not a scan.
closing the four child issues: an author proving their own control is the shape being corrected. REV verifies independently, covering aim as well as firing, and the children close on their verdict.
the G07 self-dossier: BADF-DEM-0128 is kind=discovery / status=OPEN, so self_dossier (:4007) refuses it until a human authorizes. Declared, not worked around.
acceptance_criteria: each of the four deferral watches is GREEN today and observed RED under a mutation that makes its own trigger true, with the unmutated negative control green before and after
the path-convention watch is asserted rather than documented, because four watches depend on it and if it breaks they stay green while scanning the wrong tree
every watch carries an aim proof naming READ SITE, MATCHER and REACH -- a positive control cannot detect a mis-aimed watch, since the mutation manufactures the very condition the aim gets wrong
no watch uses a depth-fixed glob: the tree contains a doubled work/WP-2026-0010/evidence/G07/G07/ holding eight tracked files, so a fixed-depth pattern is provably blind one level down

ADVERSARIAL (#270): the proposition is 'a watch is green for a reason unrelated to its trigger'. For #217, whose four named types ALREADY exist, show the discriminator is the binding and that all four pre-existing objects lack it -- green because the thing is absent, not because the watch looks where it never appears.
evidence: seven-arm mutation battery, each observed RED then restored

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: C2: adds tests only, no enforcement surface changed. The first draft carried a fifth watch for #212 scanning build.json for fields that never appear there; it was green AND its positive control PASSED, because injecting a field into the wrong file lights that file up. Removed, and the aim-proof requirement is the remedy. Authority chain openly incomplete: demand is kind=discovery with no authorized_by.
